test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

__If I was very rich__, I would spend all my time and money for the poor.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the subjunctive mood is incorrectly used.
 
• For hypothetical situations, especially in conditional sentences (starting with "if"), **'were'** should be used instead of **'was'**.
 
 
• **Example:** If I were a bird, I would fly to the skies.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution is **'If I were very rich'**.

Hence, the correct sentence is **"*If I were very rich, I would spend all my time and money for the poor*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Use the subjunctive mood with **'were'** for hypothetical or unlikely situations.

 
 
• **Example:** If he **were** here, he would be pleased.
 
 
 
• Do not use **'was'** in hypothetical scenarios starting with "if."
 
 
• **Incorrect:** If I **was** rich, I would buy a mansion.
 
• **Correct:** If I **were **rich, I would buy a mansion.
